Name: Appaloosa Horses (Barn Animals)
Author: PiratePapaya
Description:
Ever wanted more variety in your barn?
This mod adds a brand-new barn animal: the Appaloosa horse.  Yep, you can now raise horses right in your barn, just like cows or sheep. You'll find them available for purchase at Marnie's shop. This mod includes three coat patterns:[list]
[*]Leopard: These horses are totally covered in spots, giving them a really wild look.
[*]Blanket: Features a big white patch on its back and hips with spots scattered across it.
[*]Snowflake[b]:[/b] Covered in tiny, delicate white spots that look just like falling snowflakes.
[/list]Hope you enjoy having these horses on your farm!

[i][u][font=Arial][size=3]2.0 Update
[/size][/font][/u][/i]
[b][i]Diverse Products[/i][/b][b]:
[/b] Each horse now produces its own unique milk and cheese.

[i][b]Translation Support: [/b][/i]
I added an i18n folder to the mod, so it can now be translated. You can enjoy the mod in your preferred language!

[i][u][font=Arial][size=3]3.0 Update[/size][/font][/u][/i]

Small fixes and new stuff!
